summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only — no files changed)  I traced the full watchlist path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`.  **What I expected to find (per the ticket's hypothesis) but didn't:** a missing `X-User-Id`, a local/anonymous fallback, or a missing ownership check. None of that is present. Every watchlist handler filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`, the auth middleware on the watchlist router mirrors the exact pattern already used (and trusted) by the portfolio module, the client always sends `credentials
